package diagnosticplan

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	service "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"time"
)

type Clock interface{ Now() time.Time }
type Issuer struct {
	Plans        repository.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRepository
	Reservations repository.DiagnosticAssessmentReservationRepository
	Placements   repository.DiagnosticPlacementRepository
	Courses      service.DiagnosticCourseCatalogService
	Students     service.DiagnosticAssessmentStudentService
	Clock        Clock
}

func (i Issuer) Issue(ctx context.Context, key string, input domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRequestV1) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan, bool, error) {
	if i.Plans == nil || i.Reservations == nil || i.Placements == nil || i.Courses == nil || i.Students == nil || i.Clock == nil || !canonicalUUID(key) {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeDiagnosticPlanRequest(input)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, err
	}
	hash, err := digest(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, err
	}
	if normalized.RequestHash != "" {
		hash = normalized.RequestHash
	}
	if prior, err := i.Plans.GetByStudentKey(ctx, normalized.StudentID, key); err == nil {
		if domain.ValidateDiagnosticPlan(prior.Plan) != nil {
			return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if prior.RequestHash != hash {
			return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		if err := i.ensureReservation(ctx, prior.Plan); err != nil {
			return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, err
		}
		return prior.Plan, false, nil
	} else if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, err
	}
	revision := 1
	if prior, err := i.Plans.GetLatest(ctx, normalized.StudentID, normalized.CourseID, normalized.BootstrapContextDigest); err == nil {
		if domain.ValidateDiagnosticPlan(prior.Plan) != nil {
			return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if normalized.ExpectedPreviousRevision == nil || *normalized.ExpectedPreviousRevision != prior.Plan.PlanRevision {
			return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		if i.Placements == nil {
			return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		placement, placementErr := i.Placements.GetDiagnosticPlacement(ctx, prior.Plan.ID)
		if errors.Is(placementErr, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		if placementErr != nil {
			return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, placementErr
		}
		if domain.ValidateStoredDiagnosticPlacement(placement.Decision, prior.Plan, placement.RequestID, placement.RequestHash, placement.Decision.DecisionDigest) != nil {
			return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		revision = prior.Plan.PlanRevision + 1
	} else if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, err
	} else if normalized.ExpectedPreviousRevision != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	catalog, err := i.Courses.GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(ctx, normalized.CourseID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, err
	}
	if catalog.CourseID != normalized.CourseID {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	chosen, err := selectFixed(catalog.Assessments)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, err
	}
	plan := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{Schema: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchemaV1, ID: diagnosticPlanID(normalized.StudentID, normalized.CourseID, catalog.Revision, normalized.BootstrapContextDigest, revision), StudentID: normalized.StudentID, CourseID: normalized.CourseID, PlanRevision: revision, PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticFixedPolicyV1, CourseRevision: catalog.Revision, OnboardingVersion: normalized.OnboardingVersion, BootstrapPolicyVersion: normalized.BootstrapPolicyVersion, BootstrapContextDigest: normalized.BootstrapContextDigest, Assessments: chosen, CreatedAt: i.Clock.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)}
	plan.PlanDigest, err = domain.DiagnosticPlanDigest(plan)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, err
	}
	stored, err := i.Plans.Insert(ctx, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord{IdempotencyKey: key, RequestHash: hash, Plan: plan, BindingRevision: normalized.BindingRevision, BindingDigest: normalized.BindingDigest, BindingGoalCode: normalized.BindingGoalCode, BindingDirectionCode: normalized.BindingDirectionCode, BindingCreatedAt: normalized.BindingCreatedAt})
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) { // a concurrent winner may have committed after our preflight
			stored, err = i.Plans.GetByStudentKey(ctx, normalized.StudentID, key)
			if err == nil && stored.RequestHash == hash && domain.ValidateDiagnosticPlan(stored.Plan) == nil {
				if err := i.ensureReservation(ctx, stored.Plan); err != nil {
					return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, err
				}
				return stored.Plan, false, nil
			}
			return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, err
	}
	if stored.RequestHash != hash || stored.IdempotencyKey != key {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if err := i.ensureReservation(ctx, stored.Plan); err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, false, err
	}
	return stored.Plan, true, nil
}

func (i Issuer) ensureReservation(ctx context.Context, plan domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) error {
	if stored, err := i.Reservations.GetDiagnosticReservation(ctx, plan.ID); err == nil {
		if domain.ValidateStoredDiagnosticReservation(stored, plan) != nil {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		return nil
	} else if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return err
	}
	receipt, err := i.Students.ReserveDiagnosticAssessment(ctx, plan.StudentID, plan)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if domain.ValidateDiagnosticReservation(receipt, plan) != nil {
		return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	digest, err := domain.DiagnosticReservationDigest(receipt)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	record := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservationRecord{StudentID: plan.StudentID, CourseID: plan.CourseID, AttemptID: plan.ID, Reservation: receipt, ReservationDigest: digest, ReceivedAt: i.Clock.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)}
	stored, err := i.Reservations.InsertDiagnosticReservation(ctx, record)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		stored, err = i.Reservations.GetDiagnosticReservation(ctx, plan.ID)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if domain.ValidateStoredDiagnosticReservation(stored, plan) != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func (i Issuer) EnsureReservation(ctx context.Context, plan domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) error {
	return i.ensureReservation(ctx, plan)
}

func diagnosticPlanID(studentID, courseID, courseRevision, contextDigest string, revision int) string {
	// The historical pre-bootstrap formula was never deployed. Context is now a
	// named identity component, so onboarding/binding changes start at revision 1.
	seed := studentID + "\x00" + courseID + "\x00" + courseRevision + "\x00" + contextDigest + "\x00" + strconv.Itoa(revision)
	return uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(seed)).String()
}

func canonicalUUID(raw string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(raw)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == raw
}

// selectFixed is stable and content-spread: sorted catalogue positions are sampled over its whole range.
func selectFixed(in []domain.DiagnosticAssessment) ([]domain.DiagnosticAssessment, error) {
	in = domain.CanonicalDiagnosticAssessments(in)
	if len(in) < 3 {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	n := len(in)
	want := 5
	if n < 5 {
		want = n
	}
	out := make([]domain.DiagnosticAssessment, 0, want)
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for slot := 0; slot < want; slot++ {
		idx := slot * (n - 1) / (want - 1)
		a := in[idx]
		if seen[a.TaskID] {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		seen[a.TaskID] = true
		out = append(out, a)
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(a, b int) bool {
		if out[a].LessonOrder != out[b].LessonOrder {
			return out[a].LessonOrder < out[b].LessonOrder
		}
		if out[a].TaskOrder != out[b].TaskOrder {
			return out[a].TaskOrder < out[b].TaskOrder
		}
		return out[a].TaskID < out[b].TaskID
	})
	return out, nil
}
func digest(v any) (string, error) {
	b, e := json.Marshal(v)
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	s := sha256.Sum256(b)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(s[:]), nil
}
